blocks.text: GCash, the Philippines’ #1 Finance Super App, in partnership with PDAX, is making dollar investing simpler and more accessible with the launch of Retail Dollar Bonds Tranche 3 (RDB 3) on GBonds. For as low as US$200 (around ₱12,700), Filipinos can diversify their investments into US dollar-denominated government securities without the need to open a dollar bank account, visit a bank or brokerage, or manually submit lengthy paperwork. Through GBonds, users can invest directly using their GCash e-wallet balance in Philippine pesos, with the current conversion rate displayed before order confirmation.
